qualifications.name: BTh
notes: Programme scope: The BTh degree is a three-year programme that trains students particularly as youth workers, service workers, counsellors and community workers.
Programme content: Modules include Old Testament, New Testament, Systematic Theology, Ecclesiology, Practical Theology and Missiology. Students may choose to specialise in Youth Work.
Admission requirement: National Senior Certificate aggregate of at least 60%, excluding Life Orientation.

Extended degree programme: Students with an NSC aggregate of at least 55% but below 60%, excluding Life Orientation, may be considered for the extended degree programme after an interview with the Dean or a representative.
Source note: Applicants who wrote Grade 12 in 2008 or earlier should contact Stellenbosch University's Client Services Centre for the relevant admission requirements.

qualifications.name: BDiv
notes: Career opportunities: First step in ministerial training; Ministerial pathway in the Dutch Reformed Church; Ministerial pathway in the Uniting Reformed Church; Further denominational ministry training for Presbyterian, Anglican and Volkskerk ministry candidates.

Further study notes: To become a minister in the Dutch Reformed Church or Uniting Reformed Church, complete the BDiv and MDiv; Dutch Reformed Church candidates also need the Postgraduate Diploma in Theology: Christian Ministry.
Faculty aggregate note: Excluding Life Orientation.
